content.thinking: The cfg has `service: [1,1,1]` (length 3) but the model has C=2 classes. I need service of length 2 for the CNN test. Let me fix cfg4's service to [1,1] and fallback to 0 (within [0,1]).

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='dev/f1test.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("cfg4 = dict(cfg); cfg4['window'] = 4; cfg4['slots'] = 3",
            "cfg4 = dict(cfg); cfg4['window'] = 4; cfg4['slots'] = 3\ncfg4['service'] = [1, 1]; cfg4['fallback'] = 1")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
python3 dev/f1test.py 2>&1 | tail -4
